description: The Oppo Find X9 Ultra is the Android flagship that should appeal to camera enthusiasts with a decent budget who don't want to compromise on any aspect. It gets almost everything right, including impeccable cameras, a top-notch display, flagship performance, and a superior battery. If you're specifically in the market for an Ultra device, the Oppo Find X9 Ultra will not let you down.
title: Find X9 Ultra Review: Oppo's Crown Jewel

description: WWE 2K26's core gameplay remains fun and the action feels more authentic than ever. Improved presentation, through both visuals and sound, make WWE 2K26 feel immersive and authentic, while retaining its trashy, comedic, and clunky charm. But will the game feel like a meaningful upgrade to people who have played WWE 2K25? The answer is perhaps no.
title: WWE 2K26 Review: The Show Must Go On

description: Xiaomi 17T is scheduled to launch in India on June 4. Ahead of its debut, the company has confirmed a MediaTek Dimensity 8500-Ultra chipset, Leica-backed imaging features, a 6,500mAh battery and 67W HyperCharge support. Xiaomi has also teased Leica 5x telephoto photography, HyperAI features and an eye-care display. While the complete specification sheet has not been revealed, the handset is expected to share several features with the global Xiaomi 17T, which launched alongside the Xiaomi 17T Pro in international markets.
title: Xiaomi 17T India Launch Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Specifications

description: The idea behind Pawzeeble did not come from analysing business research papers or identifying a profitable gap in the market. It was conceptualised, little by little, after Sathe began taking care of Leah, a paralysed rescue pup. Like most first-time pet parents in India, Sathe had to figure out the vaccine schedule, grooming rituals, supplements, and other aspects of caring for a pet.
title: Indian Startup Pawzeeble Is Building a Pet-Focused Social Networking Space for Indian Users

description: The Lava Shark 2 5G was recently launched in India with a 6,000mAh battery and a 13-megapixel rear camera unit. It is designed to compete with the Redmi 15A 5G and Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G. Here is a detailed comparison of the Lava Shark 2 5G, Redmi 15A 5G, and Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G across pricing and specifications.
title: Lava Shark 2 5G vs Redmi 15A 5G vs Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: Asus unveiled the ROG Edition 20 lineup during the pre-event showcase of Computex 2026 on Monday, to commemorate 20 years of the ROG series. The tech giant unveiled the ROG Crosshair X870E Edition 20, its flagship motherboard. It features an integrated AIO cooling architecture, comprising the ROG Ryujin Edition 20 cooling solution and a full‑width thermal deck, which is capable of controlling the temperatures of the CPU and VRM. The company also has introduced the ROG NUC 16 Edition 20 desktop, with a “semi-transparent” black chassis and hues of gold. It features an Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 GPU, which supports DLSS 4.5, along with the QuietFlow cooling solution, and up to 300 watts of combined CPU and GPU heat dissipation. It supports up to five 4K monitors.
title: Asus ROG Edition 20 Lineup Unveiled at Computex 2026 to Commemorate 20 Years of ROG Series Products

description: Huawei Nova 16 Pro and Huawei Nova 16 Ultra launched in China with Kirin 9010S chipset and 6.84-inch OLED LTPO displays with up to a 120Hz refresh rate. The Huawei Nova 16 Pro has an IP65-rated build for dust and water resistance, while the Nova 16 Ultra has an IP68+IP69-rated build. Both phones feature a 7,000mAh battery and a quad rear camera unit headlined by a 200-megapixel main rear camera.
title: Huawei Nova 16 Pro, Nova 16 Ultra Launched With Kirin 9010S SoC, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Asus has showcased the ROG Strix Scar 18 at Computex 2026, highlighting its latest flagship gaming laptop. The device features an 18-inch 4K mini-LED display with a 240Hz refresh rate, over 2,000 dimming zones and support for ROG Nebula ELMB technology. It is powered by up to an Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus processor and an Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU. The laptop also offers up to 128GB of DDR5 RAM, up to 8TB of PCIe 5.0 SSD storage and Wi-Fi 7 connectivity.
title: Asus ROG Strix Scar 18 (2026) With 240Hz 4K Mini-LED Display Showcased at Computex 2026

description: Itel has launched its Aqua feature phone in India at Rs. 1,799. The handset features an IP67-rated design for dust and water resistance, AI Environmental Noise Cancellation, a 2.4-inch display and a 1,200mAh battery with USB Type-C charging support. It also offers Bluetooth connectivity, wireless FM radio recording, support for 10 Indian languages and up to 32GB of expandable storage. The feature phone is available in Blue, Red and Black colour options through retail stores across the country.
title: Itel Aqua Launched in India With IP67 Rating, 1,200mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Huawei Nova 16 series has been launched in China as the latest addition to the company's Nova lineup. The Huawei Nova 16 and Nova 16z are currently available for purchase in the country in Iridescent Mother of Pearl, Sky White, and Starry Black (translated from Chinese) colour options. However, the Nova 16 model is also available in a Sky Blue colourway. The standard model sports a 6.68-inch Full-HD+ OLED display, with up to 120Hz of refresh rate, 2,160Hz PWM dimming, and 300Hz touch sampling rate. It is powered by a Kirin 9010S chipset, along with 12GB of RAM and up to 512GB of onboard storage.
title: Huawei Nova 16 Launched With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera, Nova 16z Tags Along: Price, Specifications

description: AMD announced a series of new processors and platform updates ahead of Computex 2026. The US-based company’s latest lineup includes the Ryzen 7 5800X3D 10th Anniversary Edition processor, a new Ryzen 7 7700X3D CPU for the AM5 platform, and the Radeon RX 9070 GRE graphics card. The company also confirmed that it will extend support for the AM5 socket through 2029.
title: Computex 2026: AMD Unveils Ryzen 7 7700X3D, Radeon RX 9070 GRE;  Extends AM5 Support to 2029

description: HP has announced that its next-generation HP OmniBook Ultra 16 (2026) and OmniBook X 14 (2026) will be powered by the new Nvidia RTX Spark superchip. The company expects the HP OmniBook Ultra 16 (2026) and OmniBook X 14 (2026), with the Nvidia RTX Spark chip, to go on sale in select global markets later this year, and the pricing details will be revealed “closer to availability”. The new Nvidia RTX Spark-powered OmniBook Ultra 16 (2026) and OmniBook X 14 (2026) models will be built for developers and other users who wish to run AI personal agents on their devices
title: HP OmniBook Ultra 16 (2026), OmniBook X 14 (2026) Unveiled With Nvidia's RTX Spark 'Superchip'

description: Acer has unveiled the Swift Air 14 at Computex 2026, powered by Intel Core Series 3 processors and equipped with a dedicated NPU for AI workloads. The laptop features a 14-inch WUXGA 120Hz display, up to 16GB of LPDDR5 RAM, up to 512GB SSD storage and a 70Wh battery rated for up to 19 hours of video playback. Acer also announced the Swift Spin 14 AI. The Swift Air 14 will be available in multiple colour options across select global markets later this year.
title: Acer Swift Air 14 Launched With Intel Core Series 3 CPU, Lightweight Design at Computex 2026

description: Vivo X Fold 6 is tipped to launch in China by the end of June 2026. It is tipped to come with a large battery compared to its predecessor. The Vivo X Fold 6 could run on a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC and feature a 200-megapixel rear camera sensor. The Vivo X Fold 6 is said to feature a slim and lightweight body. It is likely to be available in a white colour option.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Launch Timeline Leaked; Tipped to Arrive With MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chip

description: AMD India Managing Director Vinay Sinha said artificial intelligence (AI) workloads cannot rely on a single computing architecture as adoption expands across cloud, edge, and personal devices. In an interaction with Gadgets 360, Sinha discussed AMD’s approach towards heterogeneous computing, Ryzen AI processors, Instinct GPUs, memory supply challenges, and India’s growing demand for AI-capable systems. He also highlighted the role of AMD’s ROCm ecosystem and partnerships in expanding AI adoption.
title: How AMD is Anchoring India's AI Ambitions Amid Global Headwinds, Explains Vinay Sinha

description: Apple has long been believed to be developing a pair of smart glasses. In recent months, the rumour mill has suggested that the Cupertino-based tech giant could finally unveil them soon. According to a seasoned journalist, Apple’s smart glasses could become the next major computing platform, with the brand potentially aiming to replicate the success it achieved in the smartwatch category with its Apple Watch over the past decade. The smart glasses are reportedly being positioned as a competitor to the Ray-Ban Meta Glasses and more, but have been delayed till 2027.
title: Apple’s Ray-Ban Meta Rivalling Smart Glasses Reportedly Delayed Till Next Year; Vision Air to Launch in 2029

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, the first wide-folding smartphone from the South Korean tech giant, has been spotted in a leaked real-life image, hinting at the design of the phone. The rumoured Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 appears to be covered with a camouflage skin to hide the design of the smartphone before it is officially unveiled. However, the image does show the foldable with a dual rear camera system, housed inside a pill-shaped camera module. Under the rear camera setup, an LED flash also appears.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Fold 8 Ultra Design Leaked as Rumoured Wide Foldable Turns Up in Real-Life Images

description: Apple has reportedly begun development of iOS 28, iPadOS 28 and macOS 28, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The updates are internally codenamed Bell for iOS and iPadOS and Poppy for macOS, while employees reportedly refer to the broader project as Boppy. Apple is said to be working on individual features and enhancements, with development still at an early stage. Gurman claims the 2027 software generation could deliver more significant changes than iOS 27 and may debut alongside the rumoured 20th anniversary iPhone.
title: iOS 28, macOS 28 Codenames Leaked as Apple Reportedly Begins Development Ahead of iOS 27 Release

description: The Apple TV set-top box and HomePod mini are ready to hit the shelves soon, according to a new report. Development of both devices was completed a few months ago, and they are used by Apple employees at the company's headquarters in Cupertino, California, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The HomePod Mini will have a new chip capable of supporting Apple’s latest AI-powered features. The Apple TV will also include a new chip. Gurman notes that Apple may refresh the remote in some form.
title: Apple TV and HomePod Mini Said to Be Ready to Launch, But Awaiting Apple's Siri Upgrades

description: Xbox has delayed Fable to February 2027 to better manage its portfolio of upcoming releases and give the RPG its own dedicated window. The game has also been pushed back to presumably avoid clashing with the year's biggest launch, Grand Theft Auto 6.
title: Xbox Delays Fable to February 2027 to Give It a Window 'All to Itself', Avoid Clash With GTA 6

description: Dell XPS 13 (2026) was launched in select global markets on Sunday, months after the US-based company reintroduced the XPS lineup. The new laptop sports a 13.4-inch 2.5K (2,560 x 1,600 pixels) InfinityEdge touchscreen, with up to 120Hz of variable refresh rate, up to 500 nits typical brightness, 100 percent DCI-P3 colour gamut, and Dolby Vision. It gets a dual-microphone setup, along with a full-size backlit keyboard and a quad speaker unit. The laptop is configurable up to an Intel Core Ultra 7 Series 3 355 processor, delivering a peak clock speed of 4.7GHz and a 49 TOPS NPU.
title: Dell XPS 13 (2026) Launched With 2.5K Display, Up to Intel Core Ultra 7 Series 3 Processor: Price, Specifications

description: Google Drive finally gets a major scanner upgrade. The upgrade brings Smart Batch Scanning, which allows users to scan multiple pages continuously without manually capturing each page. Auto-Best Frame automatically swaps blurry scans with clearer shots, while Duplicate Detection prevents scanning repeated pages. The new scanner is available on devices with a minimum of 8GB of RAM.
title: Google Drive's Document Scanner Gets Major Refresh With Support for Detecting Duplicates, Multiple Page Scanning

description: Apple's Beats brand appears to be preparing a new pair of over-ear headphones after football star Lamine Yamal was seen using an unannounced model in Instagram photos and videos. The headphones feature a pink finish, visible Beats branding and a revised design compared to the Beats Studio Pro. Their appearance follows a recent FCC filing for an unidentified audio device with model number A3577. While Beats has not confirmed details, the sightings suggest an official launch could take place in the near future.
title: Unreleased Beats Headphones Spotted in Lamine Yamal's Instagram Post After Visiting US FCC Database

description: Samsung Display will showcase its latest gaming-focused OLED and QD-OLED display technologies at Computex 2026, the company announced on Monday. The South Korean tech conglomerate plans to exhibit 16 gaming display products at the computer expo held in Taiwan from June 2 to June 5. Its product lineup includes compact 8.8-inch OLED panels for handheld gaming PCs, a self-emissive 4K QD-OLED monitor with a 360Hz refresh rate, and 49-inch QD-OLED monitor panels.
title: Computex 2026: Samsung Display to Showcase 4K 360Hz QD-OLED, Handheld Gaming OLED Panels

description: Acer Predator Helios 18 AI (2026) has been launched globally by the Taiwanese tech giant as its latest gaming laptop. It is confirmed to go on sale in the North American and EMEA markets in August. However, the laptop will arrive in Australia in the fourth quarter of 2026. It features up to an Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 GPU, along with an Intel Core Ultra 9 processor, up to 256GB of RAM, and up to a 6TB SSD for internal storage. The latest Acer Predator Helios 18 AI (2026) is backed by a 99Wh battery.
title: Acer Predator Helios 18 AI (2026) Launched With Intel Core Ultra 9 CPU, Up to Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 GPU

description: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra was announced on Sunday as the company’s most powerful Surface laptop ever built. Developed in collaboration with Nvidia, the Redmond-based tech giant says its new laptop is aimed at creators, developers, AI researchers, and professionals. The Surface Laptop Ultra features Nvidia's latest Blackwell RTX graphics architecture with up to 128GB of unified memory and full CUDA support for handling demanding workloads such as large AI models, 3D rendering, software compilation, and complex simulations.
title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra Announced With Blackwell RTX GPU, Nvidia RTX Spark Superchip

description: Acer Aspire X 16 AI, Acer Aspire 18 AI laptops launched alongside Acer Aspire C27 AI and Aspire C24 AI all-in-one desktops. The Acer Aspire X 16 AI laptop (AX16-I71M) supports up to the latest Intel Core Ultra X9 processors. The Aspire 18 AI laptop (A18-I71M) runs up to Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors. The Acer Aspire C 27 AI and Aspire C 24 AI all-in-one desktops come in  AMD Ryzen AI 400 series and Intel Core Ultra Series 3 CPU options.
title: Acer Aspire X 16, Aspire 18 AI Copilot+ PCs Launched Alongside Aspire C27 AI, Aspire C24 AI All-in-One Desktops

description: Acer has expanded its tablet lineup with the launch of the latest Iconia Duo tablets ahead of Computex 2026. The new Acer Iconia Duo S14, Duo S12, and Duo D12 are equipped with the company’s new 3:2 aspect ratio displays. The tablets are powered by MediaTek processors and offer support for accessories such as an Active Stylus, magnetic keyboard, and kickstand. Acer claims all three models can deliver up to 10 hours of battery life and support microSD cards up to 1TB.
title: Acer Iconia Duo S14, Iconia Duo S12 Unveiled Ahead of Computex 2026 Alongside Iconia Duo D12: Specifications
